faqs.q: What is the Fluidyne V20 32.8 cm³/rev vane pump used for?
faqs.a: The Fluidyne V20 32.8 cm³/rev vane pump is a balanced fixed-displacement vane pump of the V20 pattern, listed at 32.8 cm³/rev and up to 2,500 psi (172 bar). Vane pumps of this type run on older industrial machines, mobile power steering, refuse trucks and agricultural equipment; the full range is on the [vane pumps shelf](/c/hydraulic-vane-pumps).

faqs.q: How do I choose between the 42 part numbers of the Fluidyne V20 32.8 cm³/rev vane pump?
faqs.a: The 42 part numbers of the Fluidyne V20 32.8 cm³/rev vane pump differ by rotation, shaft length and, on some, outlet position: 29 clockwise (CW) and 13 anticlockwise (CCW), with rotation viewed from the shaft end. Examples are WF820012, WF820092, WF8201111; match rotation and shaft to the pump you are replacing, or quote the number from the old nameplate.

faqs.q: Which Vickers pumps do the Fluidyne V20 32.8 cm³/rev vane pumps replace?
faqs.a: Each part number in this listing carries the Vickers part number it replaces: WF820012 replaces Vickers Vickers V201P10P1C11R and WF820092 replaces Vickers Vickers V201S10S38C11R. Quote either the Fluidyne number or the Vickers number you hold; the 42 rows list the full match.

faqs.q: What flow does the Fluidyne V20 32.8 cm³/rev vane pump deliver?
faqs.a: At the 1,200 rpm rated speed in the table, a V20 pump of 32.8 cm³/rev delivers a theoretical 39.4 L/min, since flow is displacement times speed. Its maximum speed is 2,800 rpm; flow rises in proportion, but only if the inlet can feed the pump at that speed.

faqs.q: Which rotation and shaft options does the Fluidyne V20 32.8 cm³/rev vane pump have?
faqs.a: Rotation is viewed from the shaft end, and this listing has 29 clockwise (CW) and 13 anticlockwise (CCW). The shaft is a 3/4" straight keyed shaft in two lengths, 20 part numbers standard and 22 with the 1.75" extension, so check the old pump shaft before ordering.

faqs.q: What pressure and speed is the Fluidyne V20 32.8 cm³/rev vane pump rated for?
faqs.a: The Fluidyne V20 32.8 cm³/rev vane pump is rated up to 2,500 psi (172 bar) maximum pressure at a maximum speed of 2,800 rpm. The size table gives a rated speed of 1,200 rpm; Vickers publishes these V-series ratings on petroleum oil with 0 psi inlet, and they fall on fire-resistant fluids.

faqs.q: Which oil and inlet conditions suit the Fluidyne V20 32.8 cm³/rev vane pump?
faqs.a: Use anti-wear hydraulic oil at 13 to 54 cSt running viscosity. At its 2,800 rpm top speed the V20 32.8 cm³/rev ring draws about 91.8 L/min through the inlet, so keep the suction line short and inlet vacuum under 5 inHg, the Vickers limit on petroleum oil for V-series pumps.

faqs.q: What shaft coupling and drive does the Fluidyne V20 32.8 cm³/rev vane pump need?
faqs.a: The pump takes a 3/4" straight keyed shaft, so the coupling or flange must match that shaft and turn the pump in the right direction (CW is the main rotation here, WF820948 is one example). Drive sets and pump mounts are on the [power units and parts shelf](/c/hydraulic-power-units).

faqs.q: How is the Fluidyne V20 32.8 cm³/rev vane pump serviced or rebuilt?
faqs.a: A worn V20 32.8 cm³/rev pump is usually repaired by changing its cartridge (rotor, vanes, ring and side plates) in the existing body, and rotation is changed by reassembling the internal parts. At 172 bar working pressure the cleanliness target is ISO 4406 19/17/14, and the [vane pump guide for V10, V20 and T6](/blog/vane-pump-guide-v10-v20-t6) covers the steps.

faqs.q: Which machines typically use the Fluidyne V20 32.8 cm³/rev vane pump?
faqs.a: V20 pumps are fitted where a quiet, smooth flow is wanted, such as industrial machines, mobile power steering, refuse trucks and agricultural equipment; at 32.8 cm³/rev this one suits circuits needing about 39.4 L/min at 1,200 rpm. For more than 2,500 psi from a vane pump, the Parker T6 and T7 families in the [vane pump guide for V10, V20 and T6](/blog/vane-pump-guide-v10-v20-t6) are the usual step up.

faqs.q: How does the Fluidyne V20 32.8 cm³/rev vane pump compare with the 36.3 cm³/rev V20?
faqs.a: The Fluidyne V20 32.8 cm³/rev vane pump gives less flow per revolution than the [36.3 cm³/rev pump](/p/fluidyne-v20-vane-pumps-36-3-cm-rev), and its maximum speed is 2,800 rpm against 2,800 rpm. Both are rated up to 2,500 psi, so pick the displacement from the flow you need at your running speed.

At 172 bar working pressure the cleanliness target is ISO 4406 19/17/14, and the [vane pump guide for V10, V20 and T6](/blog/vane-pump-guide-v10-v20-t6) covers the steps.

faqs.q: Which machines typically use the Fluidyne V20P 19.5 cm³/rev vane pump?
faqs.a: V20P pumps are fitted where a quiet, smooth flow is wanted, such as industrial machines, mobile power steering, refuse trucks and agricultural equipment; at 19.5 cm³/rev this one suits circuits needing about 23.4 L/min at 1,200 rpm. For more than 2,500 psi from a vane pump, the Parker T6 and T7 families in the [vane pump guide for V10, V20 and T6](/blog/vane-pump-guide-v10-v20-t6) are the usual step up.

faqs.q: How does the Fluidyne V20P 19.5 cm³/rev vane pump compare with the other Fluidyne vane pumps?
faqs.a: It is listed at 19.5 cm³/rev against the other displacements on the shelf; a larger displacement gives more flow per revolution but a lower maximum speed. Browse the [vane pumps shelf](/c/hydraulic-vane-pumps) for the single and double pump lines.
